Maya L.: Quick follow-up from today's PM — enumerating remediation items for the recurring cache-thrash pattern. Claim what you can.

Owen J.: I can grab telemetry + alerting.

Maya L.: Item A: eviction telemetry + alert (INFR-6123). Due in 7 days. Needs dashboard, alert, runbook link.

Owen J.: Taking INFR-6123. Will set alert: >5% evictions sustained for 10m. Target 2024-04-10.

Maya L.: Item B: throttle/background job concurrency caps (INFR-6124). Due in 14 days.

Carlos V.: I'll own INFR-6124. Plan: feature-flag + staged rollout + staging test.

Nina P.: I'll pair on router fallback and review the design. Also happy to be approver on the rollback hook ticket.

Maya L.: Item C: runbook update + oncall checklist (RUN-61). Due in 5 days.

Nina P.: Taking RUN-61. Adding checklist and short customer blurb.

Maya L.: Item D: automated rollback hook for config changes (PM-801). RACI needed.

Carlos V.: I can implement the hook. Proposed RACI: Carlos (R), Nina (A), Maya (C), Owen (I).

Maya L.: Added parent ticket INFR-6200 to capture cross-cutting mitigations. Link children when ready.

ops-bot: Reminder set: Postmortem follow-up — 2024-04-12 09:00 UTC.

Owen J.: Small note: add deploy-filter to the alert to reduce noise from normal deploy spikes.

Maya L.: Good call. Also: acceptance criteria = owner, due date, PR link, verification plan (load test spec). If blocked, mark in-ticket and ping here.

Carlos V.: I'll draft the load test and attach to INFR-6200.

Maya L.: Thanks all — see you at the follow-up. :thumbsup:
